title: audit-forwarder: Terraform module for resilient CloudTrail -> OpenSearch/S3 pipeline with upgrade checks
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a single, opinionated Terraform module (audit-forwarder) to standardize cross-account CloudTrail shipping into the private deployment logging stack. The module will provision CloudTrail sink roles and KMS keys, S3 buckets with lifecycle rules (hot -> warm -> archive to Glacier), an OpenSearch ingest pipeline with index lifecycle policies, and a small set of health checks + upgrade safety mechanisms. This addresses repeated rollouts where upgrades to ILM, index templates, or retention settings caused gaps in searchability or unexpected cost spikes. The module must be usable in both VPC/private and dedicated environments and include clear upgrade flags that prevent destructive changes during in-place upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module (registry style) published in infra repo and importable with a single module call
Creates cross-account IAM role/assume-role for CloudTrail with least privilege and optional external id
S3 bucket with lifecycle rules: 90d -> transition to infrequent access, 365d -> transition to Glacier, and explicit non-expiring option for legal hold
OpenSearch index template + ILM policy applied safely (non-destructive defaults + migration path for index renames)
Automated canary: Lambda based synthetic event that verifies CloudTrail objects land in S3 and are indexed in OpenSearch within expected latency
Healthcheck endpoints (CloudWatch metrics + SNS alert) for pipeline lag, indexing errors, and S3 delivery failures
Upgrade safety: boolean flags to opt into template/ILM changes and a dry-run mode that outputs diffs and a recommended migration plan
KMS integration with customer-managed key option and permissions configured (no plaintext logs in S3)
tasks: Draft module API (inputs/outputs) and document major knobs: enable_glacier, legal_hold, kms_key_arn, canary_enabled, dry_run_upgrades
Implement IAM role and trust policy for cross-account CloudTrail delivery
Implement S3 bucket with lifecycle policy, bucket ownership enforcement, and encryption_at_rest
Create OpenSearch ingest pipeline and ILM policy with idempotent apply path
Add Lambda canary job + CloudWatch Metric filters + SNS alarm
Add Terraform tests (tflint/terratest) plus a GitHub Actions pipeline that runs terratest against a sandbox AWS account
Write migration guide and a sample playbook for rolling upgrades (canary -> small fleet -> full rollout)
Security review + threat model update and KMS key policy doc
comments: 2025-02-21 Asha Patel: Initial ticket created after incident: slow indexing after ILM change caused 8h search gaps. Requested a reusable module to avoid ad-hoc changes.

2025-02-24 Miguel Ortega: Proposed API sketch posted to design doc (link below). Key trade-off: prefer migration that creates new index aliases rather than in-place destructive template edits to avoid reindex jobs during upgrades.

2025-02-26 Design review (Elena Huang): +1 on alias-based migration. Ask: support per-customer retention override via variable? Decided: allow per-deployment override but default to org-wide guardrails.

2025-02-28 Engineering sync: agree to implement dry_run_upgrades flag that produces a plan file. We will not automatically reindex — module provides a recommended reindex job manifest that infra/ops can run.
2025-03-01 Security review kickoff (Ravi Shah): flagged KMS key admin privileges. Action: restrict CMK admin to a small SRE group and include key rotation guidance.

2025-03-02 PR opened: github.com/redwood-infer/infra/pull/1274 - initial module skeleton. Requesting reviewers: @miguel, @elena, @ravi. CI terratest currently failing due to sandbox role propagation delay.

2025-03-03 Miguel Ortega: Implemented canary Lambda and metric filters. Observed 2s median latency from CloudTrail delivery -> S3 object creation in sandbox. Next: wire OpenSearch ingest pipeline and smoke test indexing latency.
notes: Implementation notes: prefer custom resource for ILM operations when native provider is brittle; use OpenSearch API via null_resource + local-exec as a stopgap if provider lacks features
Rollback strategy: module will support a safe_mode flag that locks ILM/template changes and routes metrics to a read-only recovery dashboard
Testing approach: terratest will assert S3 object presence + simple OpenSearch query of the synthetic event; include a deliberately long retention test as an integration step separate from unit tests
